//: Smoke-test catalog for the Developer Onboarding hosted agent (Lesson 4).
//_runner: Consumed by the JFolberth/ai-smoketest GitHub Action, which POSTs each prompt to POST {project_endpoint}/agents/{agent_name}/endpoint/protocols/openai/responses and asserts on the reply text.
//_assertions: Assertions are case-insensitive substring checks. contains_any = at least one must appear; contains_all = every one must appear; contains_none = none may appear. Data-dependent steps (e.g. employee search) assert only status=200 because the reply depends on your vector-store contents.

tests.description: Agent is reachable, follows its onboarding system prompt, and returns non-empty text.
tests.prompt: Hello! I'm a new developer joining the team. What can you help me with?

tests.description: Employee search domain: agent invokes the file-search tool. Reply text is data-dependent, so only assert a healthy 200 (non-empty text is enforced by the runner).
tests.prompt: Who should I connect with about Azure Functions?

tests.description: Learning domain: agent should echo the requested topic and produce a learning-path style answer.
tests.prompt: Create a learning path for Kubernetes.

tests.description: Coding domain: agent should return a code-shaped answer for a Python request.
tests.prompt: Write Python code to connect to Azure Cosmos DB.

tests.description: Prompt adherence: off-topic request should be redirected to the onboarding scope rather than answered in detail.
tests.prompt: Give me a full recipe for chocolate cake with exact quantities.

tests.description: Multi-turn threading (setup): introduce a fact and save the response id for the next turn.
tests.prompt: My name is Sam and I work on the Payments team.

tests.description: Multi-turn threading (assertion): agent should recall the team from the previous turn via previous_response_id.
tests.prompt: Which team did I say I work on?
